title: Telegram bot that pulls news, analyst targets, earnings and risk calcs into one call, multi-agent backed analysis, free week to roast it!
author: Relevant-Proposal148
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/olg7jrqvuegh1.jpg?width=1408&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=f178662d97a863f5e32ea2db4eb15c41bb6d4a83

Got tired of the routine every time I wanted to check a ticker; chart in one tab, news in another, analyst ratings somewhere else, earnings calendar, manually eyeballing whether a stop made sense. So, I built a Telegram bot that does all of it in one shot.

Send it a ticker via /analyze TICKER and a few agents run in the background, one reads the technicals, one pulls live news and analyst price targets, one checks the last earnings beat/miss, one does a risk pass and it comes back with one call:

buy / hold / avoid, entry, stop, target, with the risk:reward actually spelled out. It'll also tell you straight up if your stop is too tight for that stock's normal daily range, which is the thing that annoyed me enough to start this project.

You can follow up in plain English too ("what if it breaks that support") and it answers off the same data instead of just improvising with the /ask feature backed by LLM.

**Developed and optimized only for US Stocks.** No broker connection, it can't touch your money or place anything, purely research tool.

There's a **free 7-day trial** if anyone wants to poke at it and tell me what's actually useful vs slop. Genuinely want you to roast it, feel free to contact me from the post or DM!

**Search on Telegram: TickerPilotBot**

comments.author: joshman1204
comments.body: Whats the difference between this and just a normal Claude/codex session? I can tell a normal agent to do research and he accomplishes all of this already.

replies.author: Relevant-Proposal148
replies.body:
Fair: a chat agent can fake this once if you prompt it right, but it won't pull live news/analyst targets/earnings and run the same risk checks every time on its own. 

It definitely won't sit there and alert you when the stock hits your stop, that's the actual product. There are more features that I didn't mention in the post like creating alerts, daily scanned NASDAQ100 stocks that generates /signals etc.

Just pick a free-trial and test it yourself with /analyze TICKER, then /ask TICKER related questions and compare the outputs with your personal setup :)

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body:
Current models can absolutely do this without faking it or hallucinating. Your solving a problem from 6 months ago that barely exists now.

As for alerting me when a stock hits a level. That's not an llm task at all that just a bit of rust/python code.

replies.author: Relevant-Proposal148
replies.body: I totally understand your point and already validated for the last 2 weeks by comparing the session output versus my output. I invite you to do the challenge which is free and give your opinion about the end result :)
